data.name: Rohanesh
data.gender_notes: Rohanesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rohanesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'rohana' and 'ish', meaning 'light' and 'god' respectively. Rohanesh signifies the god of light, representing brightness, wisdom, and positivity. The name Rohanesh carries the meaning “The Lord of Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Rohanesh usually hope their child will grow to embody the lord of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hindu philosophy, Rohanesh represents the illuminating force of the universe, guiding one towards enlightenment and knowledge.
data.etymology: Rohanesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Lord of Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rohanesh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Rohanesh is mentioned in the 'Mahabharata', an ancient Indian epic poem. He was a charioteer of Arjuna, one of the five Pandava brothers, during the Kurukshetra War in the 9th century BCE.

Another reference to Rohanesh can be found in the 'Puranas', a collection of ancient Indian texts. Rohanesh is considered an incarnation of Lord Shiva, who came to the aid of the demon king Ravana during his war against Rama, the prince of Ayodhya, in the 5th century BCE.
